true_wording: As drafted; tighter and exact: 'Every warehouse operator in the state now has to write a tornado safety plan.' claim: 'and every new warehouse needs a designated refuge area'
true_wording: The Act has no flat 'designated refuge area' mandate. Section 15 says warehouses built after the law must be designed so tornado life-safety matches the most demanding other extreme event in the building code (or, as the alternative, follow FEMA P-431 so the shelter areas named in the plan qualify as best available refuge areas). Spoken replacement: 'And warehouses built from now on have to be designed so people inside are as protected from a tornado as from the other extreme events the building code already covers.' STLPR's 'designated refuge area' is the reporter's summary; the statute wins. Alternative: cut the clause and keep the plan sentence only.
